trust_center.repositoryDescription: Abbott Diabetes Care's Trust Center provides security, privacy, compliance, FedRAMP, and product-assurance information for LibreView.
trust_center.accessRequestInstructions: The Trust Center landing page and public resources are available without authentication. Human-readable certification-data PDF: https://trust.diabetescare.abbott/resources?s=qo2fje7f0pxysyvko2cb3g&name=libre-view-fed-ramp-certification-data-pdf. Machine-readable certification-data JSON resource page: https://trust.diabetescare.abbott/resources?s=77c2ria0oy5m3swctxba5k&name=libre-view-fed-ramp-certification-data-json. Programmatic access uses the direct JSON endpoint identified in programmaticAccess.method. For a restricted resource, select Request access, provide the requested contact and company information and a reason for access, and submit the request. Previously approved viewers may select Reclaim access.

certified_services.serviceDescription: LibreView professional accounts provide clinical-practice users and authorized representatives or agents with access to LibreView functions appropriate to their roles.
LibreView uploads and synchronizes glucose-device and compatible Libre-application data for storage, review, and reporting.
LibreView stores, associates, organizes, retrieves, and presents historical glucose data, connected-device data, and supported user-entered information.

LibreView generates, displays, customizes, prints, and saves glucose reports and analytics, including marketed report types such as Ambulatory Glucose Profile, Glucose Pattern Insights, Daily Patterns, and Weekly Summary where available.

certified_services.serviceName: LibreView Practice and Care Team Administration
certified_services.serviceDescription: LibreView enables healthcare practices to create and administer Practices, Practice IDs, Care Team membership, professional invitations, and role-appropriate access to shared patient information.

certified_services.serviceName: Remote Patient Invitation and Data Sharing
certified_services.serviceDescription: LibreView provides invitation and connection workflows that allow patients to share LibreView data with an authorized healthcare Practice, allow Care Teams to review shared data remotely, and allow patients to stop sharing their data at any time.
LibreView provides a Practice-facing patient dashboard, supported patient views and flags, and supported report or data-export functions used to review and manage patient information.

current.service_desc: LibreView is a secure, cloud-based diabetes management system that gives healthcare professionals and patients clear, easy-to-understand reports from compatible FreeStyle glucose monitoring devices.
